blocks.text: The nuke symbol is now centered and slightly larger. Its new built-in artwork stays consistent across phone fonts, making the button easier to recognize.
The button keeps its existing position and touch area. Nuke effects and gameplay balance are unchanged.
核彈標示已置中並稍微放大。改用遊戲內建圖示，避免不同手機字型造成偏移，讓按鈕更容易辨識。
按鈕的位置與觸控範圍維持原樣，核彈特效與遊戲平衡沒有變更。
